title: Full-catalog GISMo exact-pair feedback overlay

methodology.model: Released GISMo epoch-800 checkpoint with frozen graph, embeddings, scoring layers, contexts, and 6,653-candidate catalog
methodology.feedback_proxy: 49,044 official training substitutions treated as accepted events; these are not users or observed satisfaction
methodology.evaluation: 10,747 official test cases, pessimistic tie ranking, and a frozen 5,000-replicate paired bootstrap
methodology.identity_limit: The experiment canonicalizes directed source-target pairs; the current runtime key is only lowercased and has no user, session, technique, cuisine, or context identity

conclusion: The exact-pair overlay raises aggregate MRR through seen-pair memorization but harms unseen-pair MRR beyond the predeclared limit. It is rejected for production ranking.
claim_boundary: Training substitutions are an acceptance proxy, not observed user satisfaction or causal behavioral evidence
Exact-pair memorization is not generalization, personalization, context awareness, or emergent discovery
The runtime feedback path remains disconnected from the scorer and cannot be called end-to-end learning
